text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
What a powerful run! The one conquering 
the Copa Republica Argentina is—

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: *wheeze*... *pant*... ...Shh...!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
(...If I remember right, there are 
Senior-class Umamusume running in this 
too... aren't there...?)

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
I can actually do this...! I'm in top 
shape...!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: With this—

text_block_list.name: Gal Umamusumes
text_block_list.text: Jordan! Yaaaaaay!!

text_block_list.name: Gal Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Holy crap! Jordan's on fire!! Her stride 
can stretch out that far!?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, that's right! Our friend is super 
strong!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
"I can't afford to fall behind either! 
Let's get hyped and crush this training!"

text_block_list.name: Gal Umamusume B
text_block_list.text: Aweeesooommmeeee! JOOOORDAAAAN!!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Pfft... Haha...! You sure can yell pretty 
damn loud...!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
This ain't over yet! I can still go higher 
than this!!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
"I'm gonna get way bigger! I'm gonna run 
in that race, too! Uhm—"

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: A-ri-ma Ki-nen!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
So yeah, countin' on ya~. That's a super 
crazy GⅠ, right?

After making a bold declaration at the 
racetrack, Tosen Jordan casually asked to 
enter the Arima Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Of course! I already declared it. At this 
point, I have to, right?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
...I wanna look even cooler in front of 
those guys, too.

text_block_list.name: Doctor
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... From a medical standpoint, I have 
no objections. In fact, running in any of 
those races would be fine.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Ehh~!? But I wanna run the Arima Kinen! I 
saw in a magazine that it's an amazing 
race!

text_block_list.name: Doctor
text_block_list.text:
That is not what I mean... —What I mean 
is, my hoof has completely healed.

text_block_list.name: Doctor
text_block_list.text:
Yes. It is the result of both of you 
confronting the injury and putting in the 
effort. There is nothing to worry about... 
It is a beautiful, healthy hoof.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
...!! R-Really, for real!? You're not 
Jordin' around, my nails are really...!

text_block_list.name: Doctor
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, yes. You've truly done well. To 
recover this much... It wouldn't be an 
exaggeration to call it a miracle.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: A miracle...

text_block_list.name: Doctor
text_block_list.text:
Make sure to thank your Trainer as well 
for coming all the way to the hospital so 
many times.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
"...I am. 'Cause I do it all the time with 
this one."

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Ah...... Well... but still.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: ...Thank you very much.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
...Aaaah, what is that even supposed to 
mean!? Don't tease me!!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Dummy, duuuummy!

A week passed after that. The Trainers 
were buzzing with a certain rumor.

text_block_list.name: Mid-Level Trainer A
text_block_list.text:
This year's Tiara route is seriously wild. 
There's already someone aiming for the 
world stage, right?

text_block_list.name: Mid-Level Trainer B
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. If you're talking about the 
strongest active Umamusume right now, it'd 
probably be one from the Tiara route...

text_block_list.name: Mid-Level Trainer A
text_block_list.text:
"No way... 'Strongest active runner' is 
really pushing it. I mean, look, those 
girls are running in the next Arima Kinen, 
too."

text_block_list.name: Mid-Level Trainer B
text_block_list.text:
All those crowd-favorites are indeed 
declaring their entry into the race... 
This Arima Kinen might just be the clash 
to decide who's the strongest.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
And tomorrow, meteors will fall... This is 
gonna be one crazy match...

text_block_list.name: Mid-Level Trainer A
text_block_list.text:
Well, that sounds hopeless... Guess I'll 
let my mom know, too...

text_block_list.name: Mid-Level Trainer A
text_block_list.text: ...Huh?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Welcome☆ Delivery to Mars, table for one 
right this way~♪ The boarding gate will be 
that tire over there~♪

text_block_list.name: Mid-Level Trainer A
text_block_list.text:
W-Whoa!? Stop, what are you planning to do 
to me!?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
"Name the digits of pi! 3.1415926535... 
What comes next?!"

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
"Your reaction time is way too slow! 
You'll never dodge an attack from the Turf 
Aliens like that, will ya!? Alright, next 
Trainer! C'mon!"

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: ...What is that?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Nah. Less 'amazing', more 'stupid'. I 
mean, she's totally nuts.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
"And yet, every time I race, I'm always 
first or second favorite... right? ...I 
just don't get it."

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
If you can't solve it, go hit the tires!! 
I'll lend you my custom hammer!!

text_block_list.name: Rookie Trainer A
text_block_list.text: Eeeh...?

Is that... sledgehammer training? It's 
effective for whole-body strength. Though 
I have no idea why she's dragged someone 
else into it...
choice_data_list:
Was there actually any thought behind your 
actions...?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
...Is that a habit of yours? You always 
tie everything back to training. Is your 
brain okay?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: No way. Not at all. I mean, it's Golshi.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Forget about that, focus, focus! Focus on 
the Arima Kinen that I'm running in!
choice_data_list:
The "Arima Kinen" is going to be a tough 
race.

I think the "Arima Kinen" will be a tough 
race.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
I get it, I get it. But we can totally do 
this, right? You saw it too, didn't you?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
"Look at how I ran in the Copa Republica 
Argentina! Even against Senior-class 
rivals, I held my own."

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
I do check whether I can run or not, at 
least. Look, even in the popularity vote—

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
28th place as of right now! Isn't that 
crazy?! And that's right after saying "I'm 
entering the race~" the other day.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
"Isn't everyone super hyped for me now? 
Could 1st place on race day actually 
happen?"

text_block_list.name: Gal Umamusumes
text_block_list.text:
Jordan! I picked the spot for the Arima 
after-party! I'll send it to the group 
chat!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Thanks!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Well, we've managed to work things out so 
far, right? In that case, don't we just 
gotta give it our all?

Tosen Jordan declares that with total 
nonchalance.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Figuring out how to do your best is on 
you, though. Well, as for me...

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
"...I'm just an idiot, after all. So with 
that said, I'm counting on you!"

text_block_list.name: Passerby A
text_block_list.text:
Hey, look at this! Look, look! It's the 
entry list for the Arima Kinen, but...

text_block_list.name: Passerby B
text_block_list.text:
"Yeah, yeah, I've heard that dozens of 
times. It's an amazing lineup, right? 
...Oh, there's even some nostalgic names 
here."

text_block_list.name: Passerby B
text_block_list.text:
"This Tosen Jordan girl! I'm pretty sure 
she made quite a splash in the Satsuki 
Sho, right?"

text_block_list.name: Passerby A
text_block_list.text:
Ah, the one from half a year ago... Wait, 
no! My fave is going to appear! This girl 
right here—

...One month remaining until the 'Arima 
Kinen'.
